Grandad's DetoursBritish Side-Quests: an escape room in five pockets

00:00/ 60:00

How it works

  1. 1
    Click the letter in the suitcase and read what Grandad wants. At the end of the letter you can start.
  2. 2
    Open the pockets one after the other. You start with pocket 1.
  3. 3
    In every room you find three papers: A, B and C. Read them.
  4. 4
    Click the locked object. Answer four questions. Every right answer gives you one number of the code.
  5. 5
    Enter the code. Inside you find a piece of a postcard.
  6. 6
    After five pockets, put the postcard together. Then save your summary as a PDF.

Before you start

  • You can work alone or with a partner.
  • Your answers are saved on this iPad. You can go back with the buttons at the top.
  • Small numbers like graveyard1 mean: the explanation is at the bottom of the paper.
